description: Reviewed write families without a behavioral conformance descriptor (QA-02, tests/reviewed-family-conformance.test.mjs). Remove a family when its descriptor lands in tests/family-descriptors/ and lower the ceiling to the new count; never add a family or raise the ceiling: a new family ships its descriptor. Backfill order: activation and budget-affecting families first (the registry marks spend-affecting families with spendConfirmation), then destructive, then settings.

parked.description: Lifecycle-parked exemptions: families of a provider whose work is parked (PRK-02; parkedProviders in tools/provider-lifecycle.ts, today Criteo). They need no descriptor while the provider stays parked; the test fails once the provider is unparked, and then each one ships a descriptor. Remove an entry when its descriptor lands and lower the ceiling; never add one for an active provider.
